headline: Renames a Postal Service building in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, after Caesar H. Wright Jr.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 213 William Hilton Parkway in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, the Caesar H. Wright Jr. Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation applies from that date.
